reuse.why: All four steps go through the existing getBulkBudgetCategories selection and the new action reuses averageToBudget and getSheetValue, but the #fixed check is a raw substring match instead of the existing extractTagsFromText tag parser in shared/tags.ts.

duplication.why: Every exclusion is added once inside the shared selection function; the new action duplicates no selection or sign logic.

placement.why: Exclusion rules live in getBulkBudgetCategories in actions.ts and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts with its siblings.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the month-wide actions, their shared selector, the new handler, tests and nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: One selector with one boolean option is easy to own; the includes('#fixed') check also matches tags like #fixedcost, and reusing averageToBudget for a single month's spending stretches its name.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getBulkBudgetCategories in server/budget/actions.ts detects the #fixed tag with cat.group_notes?.includes('#fixed') instead of shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated; the tag check is a reimplementation, not a copy.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories' includeHidden option is replaced by includeHiddenCategories (net zero parameters), the template and #fixed exclusions are folded into its single exclusion condition, and all six month-wide actions, including setLastMonthSpending, call it.
